description: Defines types, constants, and functions for accessing system time and timers, including monotonic and wall clock times, with conversion utilities between different time epochs.

methods.name: SbTimeToPosix
methods.description: Converts SbTime (microseconds since 1601) to POSIX time (microseconds since 1970).

methods.name: SbTimeFromPosix
methods.description: Converts POSIX time (microseconds since 1970) to SbTime (microseconds since 1601).

methods.name: SbTimeNarrow
methods.description: Safely narrows a high-precision time value to a less precise one, rounding negative values toward negative infinity.

methods.name: SbTimeGetNow
methods.description: Retrieves the current system time as SbTime.

methods.name: SbTimeGetMonotonicNow
methods.description: Retrieves a monotonically increasing timestamp representing the current time.

methods.name: SbTimeIsTimeThreadNowSupported
methods.description: Checks if platform supports retrieving thread-specific time.

methods.name: SbTimeGetMonotonicThreadNow
methods.description: Retrieves a monotonically increasing timestamp for the current thread's execution time.
